# ComplianceSeverity

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Severity of a compliance finding, most-severe first.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `Error`: A PDF/UA-1 requirement is violated; the document is not conformant.
- `Warning`: Likely-inaccessible authoring the spec strongly discourages.
- `Info`: Advisory context (e.g. the document opted out of tagging entirely).
